registry.description: Delight is the positive pleasure of the whole person engaged with something genuinely good — not just satisfaction but the active enjoyment of what one loves. The Hebrew vocabulary is exceptionally rich, covering pleasure, sensory enjoyment, the delight of taste and smell, and the deeper satisfaction of what one treasures. God delights in his people; his people are called to delight in him. Delight is one of the strongest indicators of where a person's heart actually is: what we delight in is what we truly value.
